email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 25-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGluca via oral.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Kim (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter435@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
